world.title: Major U.S. Oil Port Selected for Nuclear Power Project
world.summary: Corpus Christi and Long Beach have been chosen to explore the integration of small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) to enhance the resilience of these key U.S. ports. The initiative aims to expand nuclear power usage across various industries and advance SMR technology. This project reflects a growing interest in diversifying energy sources and improving energy security at critical infrastructure locations.

world.title: US urges G20 to cut trade imbalances, focus on China
world.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called on G20 nations to address trade imbalances, particularly concerning Chinese imports. He advocates for measures similar to those used during the Trump administration, including tariffs, to protect domestic economies. Bessent's remarks emphasize the need for collective action among G20 members to mitigate the economic impact of China's trade practices.

world.title: Pak takes SCO chair, PM Modi slams use of terror as strategic asset
world.summary: Pakistan has assumed the chair of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO). In response, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized that security is essential for regional development. He issued a warning to Pakistan, stating that nations utilizing terrorism as a strategic asset must receive a strong message. Modi's remarks highlight ongoing tensions regarding state-sponsored terrorism in the region.

business.title: D-St set for a negative opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
business.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed slightly above 24,000 despite market pressures from high crude oil prices and geopolitical uncertainties. Analysts predict Nifty will trade between 23,800 and 24,600. Notably, both foreign portfolio investors and domestic institutions engaged in net buying on Tuesday, indicating some underlying support in the market amid the challenging conditions affecting overall sentiment.

business.title: NSE, BSE equity derivatives turnover hits multi-month low in August amid CAS volatility
business.summary: In August, equity derivatives turnover on the NSE and BSE dropped to multi-month lows, attributed to the new Closing Auction Session's impact on trading dynamics. Traders are reportedly exiting positions earlier to mitigate risks associated with market volatility. The regulatory body has confirmed that this session mechanism will remain a permanent feature in the trading landscape.

business.title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
business.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Fable 5.1, which features reduced cache-read costs alongside advancements in coding and research capabilities. In contrast, Claude Mythos 5.1 remains accessible only to vetted users, focusing on cybersecurity and life sciences. While Fable is generally available, Mythos is restricted to select individuals, emphasizing the company's commitment to safety and specialized applications in technology.

technology.title: How to Convert Xbox Discs to Digital Games: A Step-by-Step Guide
technology.summary: Xbox has launched a disc-to-digital feature allowing users to convert eligible physical game discs into digital entitlements. This process enables players to access supported titles without needing to insert the disc. The feature is particularly beneficial for Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S owners, simplifying game access and enhancing the gaming experience for those with physical collections.

technology.title: Rockstar reveals GTA Online RP server: Can regular players join the invite-only beta?
technology.summary: Rockstar Games announced the beta testing of nopixel V, an officially sanctioned version of the NoPixel custom GTA V server, starting September 8, 2026. The testing will be conducted through the Rockstar Games Launcher. Initially, the beta will be invite-only, raising questions about whether regular players will have the opportunity to join the testing phase later.

technology.title: Android’s new trick for finding lost items without a tracker rolls out soon
technology.summary: Android 16+ users will soon access a new Remembered tab in Find Hub, allowing them to save locations and optional photos of untagged items. This feature enables users to retrieve forgotten items with contextual details by asking Gemini. The update aims to enhance the user experience by providing a practical solution for locating lost belongings without needing a tracker.

sports.title: Official: Manchester City sign Enzo Fernández from Chelsea
sports.summary: Manchester City has officially signed Enzo Fernández from Chelsea. In a heartfelt message, Fernández expressed his emotional struggle in leaving Chelsea, where he felt at home for three years. He acknowledged the difficulty of the decision and the attachment he developed to the club and its community. The transfer marks a significant change in his career.

sports.title: Michael Jordan bought $2.8 million Lake Norman property in 2013, demolished old six-bedroom, eight-bathroom mansion in 2025; new estate now takes shape in aerial pictures
sports.summary: Michael Jordan purchased a Lake Norman property for $2.8 million in 2013. In 2025, he demolished the existing six-bedroom, eight-bathroom mansion to make way for a new estate. Recent aerial images show the progress of the construction, marking the latest development in Jordan's luxury real estate ventures in North Carolina.

sports.title: Chelsea strike late deadline day agreement for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara as Enzo Fernandez replacement
sports.summary: Chelsea has finalized a £47 million deal to sign midfielder Lamine Camara from Monaco on deadline day. The agreement comes as a response to the departure of Enzo Fernandez, who is set to join Manchester City. Camara is currently undergoing a medical examination as he prepares to join the Premier League club and fill the midfield gap.

health.title: All About Peptides: Making the Most of Longevity Medicine’s Latest Development
health.summary: Peptides are gaining prominence in regenerative medicine as innovative therapies evolve. These short chains of amino acids interact with receptors, triggering specific cellular responses and acting as messengers in the body. Their precise and powerful nature positions them as significant tools in longevity medicine, potentially enhancing treatments and improving health outcomes as research continues to explore their capabilities.

health.title: AIIMS experts call for earlier detection of growing GI disease burden
health.summary: AIIMS experts emphasize the need for earlier detection of increasing gastrointestinal (GI) diseases, noting that one in three people globally experiences GI or liver-related symptoms. They highlight that nearly half of the population is infected with Helicobacter pylori. The rising burden of these diseases necessitates improved diagnostic measures and awareness to address the growing health crisis effectively.

health.title: ESC 2026 Conference: Earlier Statin Use After Type 2 Diabetes Diagnosis Associated With Lower Dementia Risk
health.summary: A Danish observational study indicates that statin use in patients with type 2 diabetes is linked to a 15% lower risk of dementia. Moreover, initiating statin therapy earlier after diagnosis correlates with an even greater reduction in risk. Researcher Shoaib Afzal from the University of Copenhagen discusses the implications of these findings for clinical practice.

science.title: Exploring period blood’s regenerative potential
science.summary: Research is investigating the regenerative potential of period blood, traditionally viewed as waste. Scientists are examining its components for clues about tissue repair and potential medical treatments. While laboratory findings show promise, experts caution against claims that period blood can directly heal wounds. The focus remains on separating scientific evidence from exaggerated assertions regarding its therapeutic applications.

science.title: NASA restarts Swift telescope after failed rescue, but its future is far from certain
science.summary: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has resumed scientific operations after a failed orbital rescue mission. The telescope had been in a low-drag configuration for months while awaiting assistance, but the planned rescue did not occur. Despite its return to functionality, Swift's orbit is rapidly decaying, leaving its future uncertain as the agency assesses next steps.

science.title: University of Idaho team discovers 'Vandal' spider found only in the Gem State
science.summary: A University of Idaho research team has identified a new spider species, named the 'Vandal' spider, in the mountains of north-central Idaho. This species is believed to be unique to a specific, isolated habitat within the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests. The discovery highlights the region's biodiversity and the importance of preserving its ecosystems for future research.

entertainment.title: Aquarius Horoscope Today: September 2, 2026
entertainment.summary: Aquarius individuals are encouraged to focus on their relationships today, as positive developments are anticipated. A long-awaited desire is set to manifest, bringing a sense of fulfillment. This period marks a transition into a gentler form of empowerment, emphasizing self-awareness rather than the need for validation. Staying attuned to personal feelings will enhance connections and overall well-being.

entertainment.summary: On September 2, 2026, Leos may experience a shift from tranquility to drama as hidden truths come to light. The horoscope suggests that Leos have an innate ability to uncover mistruths, indicating that unresolved issues will emerge. This day emphasizes the importance of facing reality, as the stars align to encourage honesty and transparency in relationships.

entertainment.summary: On September 2, 2026, Capricorns can expect a steady flow of ideas, which are beginning to develop like shoots with leaves and buds.
